description_expanded: Overview5.0(2 reviews)Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Beach Home!* Short walk to the Beach * Private Pool (Pool Heating Available – Available November 1–May 31 for an additional fee $75/night)* Steps to Stinky's Fish Camp * 4 Complimentary Bikes * Garage Hangout – Ping pong table and TV provide extra space for everyone to have fun* Multiple Covered Porches and Patios – Plenty of outdoor space for morning coffee and evening cocktails* Great West End Location – Close to Gulf Place, Sandestin, dining, shopping, golf, and entertainment* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Blue Grouper is a custom-designed 4-bedroom, 3 full + 2 half-bath beach home with a sleeping nook and more than 2,500 square feet of comfortable living space. Located on the peaceful West End of 30A, this spacious retreat is just 300 yards from the beach and within easy walking distance of Stinky's Fish Camp and other local favorites. The fenced backyard features a private pool, grilling area, lounge space, and shaded seating, while multiple covered porches and patios provide plenty of room to relax. Inside, you'll find a gorgeous custom kitchen, inviting living spaces, and a fun garage hangout with ping pong and a TV. With three king bedrooms, a bunk room, and a queen sleeper in the sleeping nook, Blue Grouper is the perfect choice for families or groups looking for space, comfort, and an unbeatable 30A location.The Bed Setup:1st Floor:Guest Bedroom: King Bed 2nd Floor:Master Bedroom: King Bed Guest Bedroom: King Bed Bunk Room: Twin Bunk Bed Sleeping Nook: Queen Sleeper Sofa Exterior Security Cameras: Cameras are located at the doorbell, driveway, and pool equipment area. There are no cameras inside the home or in common guest-use areas.Area Attractions:30A is a fantastic destination; the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone: kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. The Gulf Place community is located along a 26-mile stretch of sugar-white sand and turquoise waters of Northwest Florida’s celebrated Emerald Coast. As one of the 16 distinct beach neighborhoods in South Walton, it has its own distinct character and charm. This colorful community on 30A is comprised of 25 acres located in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach on the corner of 30A and 393. Gulf Place was specifically designed to slow visitors and locals down with palm tree-lined streets, wide sidewalks, colorful outdoor patios with large umbrellas, nature walking trails, green spaces, and ample park benches to sit and enjoy the views. Gulf Place is unique from all the other South Walton neighborhoods. Residents and guests gather here to enjoy original art, boutique shopping, local cuisine, live music and a laid-back atmosphere.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Seahorse Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 715 feet out from the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Seahorse Reef is at a depth of 13-18 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy!Show less
